supporting_pages.title: "Migrate VM disks and attach them to a new VM \_|\_ Migrate to Virtual Machines\
evidence_snippets: Step 3: Configure the target for a migrated VM disk Migrate to Virtual Machines lets you migrate the disks of a source VM to Persistent Disk volumes on Google Cloud with the following options: Migrate the disks to Persistent Disk volumes Migrate the disks to Persistent Disk volumes and attach them to a new VM instance You must configure the target details such as project, zone, disk type, and more based on the option you choose.

Initiate replication of a source VM To initiate replication of a source VM, follow these steps: Open the Migrate to Virtual Machines page in the Google Cloud console: Go to the Migrate to Virtual Machines page Select the VM Disk Migrations tab.

If you have created a new VM instance and attached the migrated Persistent Disk volumes to it, Migrate to Virtual Machines deploys a clone of the VM instance to a Compute Engine instance in your target environment to test it.
